answer: Each identity leases one jetty drying shed and posts a 70-credit bond. Fresh lotus petals dry only there; a meter logs pond cooling water per batch, each sealed with an umber tag. First shed: 30; kth: 30+7(k-1); 1000th: 7023; 1000 fakes pay 3,526,500 plus 70,000 in bonds, since leases cannot be shared. An auditor checks each claim against the shed meter, the pond gauge log for that hour, and the tag registry; a sharing ring fails because one gauge cannot show two batches at once, and mismatch burns the bond. An honest operator pays 30 once, recovering it after a clean epoch.
